target_definition: Issuer Chapter 7/11 petition with an explicit primary Item 1.03 filing observed by calendar-year horizon plus 200 days; subsidiary-only reports excluded. This is a disclosure target, not exhaustive court-bankruptcy coverage.
model_selection: Company-cross-fitted weighted calibration log loss, then Brier; no final scores until selection frozen.
sampling: Certainty sample of publisher event-candidate companies plus independent 10% background sample. Year-proxy-dependent role probabilities are strictly between zero and one. Every row carries inverse sampling times role inclusion probability, irrespective of its actual label.
frame: Original nonfinancial 10-K filers in 2022 for calibration and 2024 for final; prior model-study companies excluded. Evidence review alone is not model training or tuning.
